greenhouse_eu:marvelfusion:4707598101.title: Electrical Engineer (f/m/x)
greenhouse_eu:marvelfusion:4707598101.description:
Who we are

Founded in 2019, Marvel Fusion is Europe’s leading fusion energy company, uniting 120 scientists, engineers, and entrepreneurs across our locations in Munich and Colorado.

Backed by over €385 million in public and private funding, we’re driven by a shared mission: to deliver clean, abundant energy to the world.

Why Marvel Fusion

By joining us, you will be:

  • Solving one of the most complex technological challenges known to humanity, harnessing Fusion on Earth
  • Part of a highly purpose-driven team working on providing the world with clean, safe and abundant energy
  • Working alongside world-leading scientists and entrepreneurs in the field of Fusion
  • Part of a start-up where growth on a company and individual level is the default

Deine Wirkung

In dieser vielseitigen Rolle bist du die zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen Engineering und Experimentalphysik. Du übersetzt komplexe Anforderungen in robuste elektrische Lösungen. Gemeinsam mit einem interdisziplinären Engineering-Team konzipierst, baust und validierst du hochwertige Versuchsaufbauten mit anspruchsvollen elektromechanischen Systemen. Deine Arbeit trägt direkt zum Erfolg unserer Experimentkampagnen bei: Du sorgst für sichere, zuverlässige und sauber strukturierte elektrische Systeme in einem Hochspannungsumfeld. Mit etablierten Best Practices und Normen ermöglichst du Spitzenforschung auf höchstem Sicherheits- und Technikniveau.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Konstruktion und Dokumentation elektrischer Systeme in EPLAN Electric P8 und EPLAN Cable Pro D, inkl. Stromlaufplänen, Klemmenplänen, Makros und Kabellisten
  • Konzeption, Aufbau und Verdrahtung von Schaltschränken, Gehäusen und PDUs für Nieder- und Hochspannungsanwendungen
  • Festlegung und Umsetzung fachgerechter Kabelführung, Schirmung, Kennzeichnung und Montage
  • Auswahl und Integration von Relais, Fehlerstromschutzschaltern (RCD/RCBO), Schützen, Leistungsschaltern und weiteren Schutzeinrichtungen
  • Durchführung elektrischer Gefährdungsbeurteilungen und Festlegung von Schutzmaßnahmen für Schaltschränke und Anlagen
  • Übernahme der Rolle als Verantwortliche Elektrofachkraft (VEFK) für Anlagen in deinem Zuständigkeitsbereich – falls du die Qualifikation noch nicht hast, nach Abschluss der von uns finanzierten VEFK-Weiterbildung
  • Unterstützung bei Inbetriebnahme, Prüfung und Fehlersuche, intern und bei Experimentkampagnen vor Ort
  • Mitwirkung an Design-Reviews zu Schaltschranklayout, Schutzkonzepten, Erdung und EMV
  • Pflege einer strukturierten Dokumentation inkl. Schaltplänen, Stücklisten und Konformitätsnachweisen
  • Erstellung von Projektzeitplänen, Budgetverfolgung und Koordination der Beschaffung für Schaltschrank- und Gehäuseaufbauten
  • Organisation paralleler Projekte: Fortschritt, offene Aufgaben und Prioritäten behältst du stets im Blick

Was du mitbringst

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium der Elektrotechnik oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung oder eine Qualifikation als Meister:in bzw. Techniker:in mit entsprechender Berufserfahrung
  • Mindestens 3 Jahre einschlägige Berufserfahrung
  • Fundierte Praxiserfahrung mit EPLAN Electric P8 und EPLAN Cable Pro D
  • Erfahrung in Aufbau, Verdrahtung und Inbetriebnahme von Schaltschränken, Gehäusen und PDUs für Nieder- und Hochspannungsanwendungen
  • Sicherer Umgang mit Kabelführung, Crimpen, Schirmung und professionellen Montagetechniken
  • Du kannst elektrische Zeichnungen, Stromlaufpläne und Verdrahtungspläne lesen, interpretieren und erstellen
  • Gute Kenntnisse von Relais, RCDs/RCBOs, Schützen, Leistungsschaltern und Sicherheitseinrichtungen
  • Erfahrung in der Erstellung elektrischer Gefährdungsbeurteilungen
  • Kenntnis deutscher und europäischer Normen und Vorschriften wie DIN VDE 0100, DIN EN 61439, DIN EN 60204-1 und DGUV Vorschrift 3
  • VEFK-Qualifikation – oder die fachlichen Voraussetzungen und die Bereitschaft, sie zu erwerben. Eine fehlende VEFK-Zertifizierung ist kein Ausschlusskriterium: Wir bieten dir die Möglichkeit einer von Marvel Fusion finanzierten Weiterbildung inkl. Zertifizierung.
  • Gute organisatorische und planerische Fähigkeiten, inkl. Budgetverfolgung und Koordination mehrerer Projekte
  • Gute Englischkenntnisse und Reisebereitschaft für Experimentkampagnen vor Ort

Wünschenswert

  • Kenntnisse von Normen für Leiterplatten wie IEC 61191-1
  • Erfahrung mit mechanischer Bearbeitung, 3D-Druck oder Laserschneiden

greenhouse_eu:marvelfusion:5031756101.title: Electrical (Lab) Engineer
greenhouse_eu:marvelfusion:5031756101.description:
Who we are

Founded in 2019, Marvel Fusion is Europe’s leading fusion energy company, uniting 120 scientists, engineers, and entrepreneurs across our locations in Munich and Colorado.

Backed by over €385 million in public and private funding, we’re driven by a shared mission: to deliver clean, abundant energy to the world.

Why Marvel Fusion

By joining us, you will be:

  • Solving one of the most complex technological challenges known to humanity, harnessing Fusion on Earth
  • Part of a highly purpose-driven team working on providing the world with clean, safe and abundant energy
  • Working alongside world-leading scientists and entrepreneurs in the field of Fusion
  • Part of a start-up where growth on a company and individual level is the default

The impact you will make

In this multifaceted and exciting role, you will act as a key interface between the Engineering and Experimental Physics teams, translating complex requirements into robust electrical solutions. You will work alongside a multidisciplinary team of engineers to design, build and validate high quality experimental setups involving advanced electromechanical systems. Your work will have a direct impact on the success of experimental campaigns, ensuring safe, reliable and properly structured electrical systems in a demanding, high voltage environment. By applying engineering best practices and standards, you will enable advanced research while maintaining the highest levels of safety and technical excellence.

Your responsibilities

  • Design and document electrical systems in EPLAN Electric P8 and EPLAN Cable Pro D, including schematics, terminal diagrams, macros and cable lists
  • Design, build and wire control cabinets, enclosures and PDUs for low voltage and high voltage applications
  • Define and apply proper cable routing, shielding, labeling and assembly practices
  • Select and integrate relays, RCDs/RCBs, contactors, circuit breakers and other protective devices
  • Perform electrical risk assessments and define mitigation measures for cabinets and systems
  • Act as Verantwortliche Elektrofachkraft (VEFK) for systems within your area of responsibility
  • Support commissioning, testing and troubleshooting internally and during onsite experimental campaigns
  • Participate in design reviews covering cabinet layout, protection concepts, grounding and EMC
  • Maintain structured documentation including schematics, BOMs and compliance records
  • Plan project timelines, track budgets and coordinate procurement for cabinet and enclosure builds
  • Keep projects organized, tracking progress, open tasks and priorities across parallel builds

What you bring

  • Degree in Electrical or Electronics Engineering, or a Meister/Techniker qualification with equivalent experience
  • Minimum of 3 years of relevant experienceStrong hands on experience with EPLAN Electric P8 and EPLAN Cable Pro D
  • Experience building, wiring and commissioning cabinets, enclosures and PDUs for low voltage and high voltage applications
  • Solid understanding of cable routing, crimping, shielding and professional assembly techniques
  • Ability to read, interpret and create electrical drawings, schematics and wiring diagrams
  • Good knowledge of relays, RCDs/RCBs, contactors, circuit breakers and safety devices
  • Experience performing electrical risk assessments for electrical systems
  • Knowledge of German and European standards such as DIN VDE 0100, DIN EN 61439, DIN EN 60204-1 and DGUV Vorschrift 3
  • Qualified as VEFK, or eligible and willing to obtain this qualification
  • Good organizational and planning skills, including budget tracking and coordinating multiple projects
  • Good communication skills in English, willingness to travel for onsite campaigns

Nice to have

  • German language skills
  • Knowledge of PCB design standards such as IEC 61191-1
  • Experience with machining, 3D printing or laser cutting

What we offer

Our mission is motivation enough for many. But we also support our team with benefits that foster wellbeing and growth:

  • Public transport reimbursement
  • EGYM Wellpass fitness club access
  • Complimentary health insurance
  • Professional development support
  • Company pension plan
  • Healthy office snacks

greenhouse_eu:marvelfusion:5020642101.description:
Who we are

  • Working alongside world-leading scientists and entrepreneurs in the field of Fusion
  • Part of a start-up where growth on a company and individual level is the default

The impact you will make

Without student support, operational routine tasks such as order tracking, quote collection, master data maintenance and application testing remain with the procurement managers. This ties up senior capacity that is needed for strategic sourcing, supplier negotiations and the support of experimental projects. As order volumes grow and logistics become more complex with the move to multiple sites, we expect longer order cycle times, gaps in master data quality and incomplete audit documentation. The latter is a direct risk for IPO readiness. Process digitalization (e.g. the Marvelous Request Center) would also progress more slowly, as there is no capacity for testing and documentation.

Your responsibilities

  • You will support our procurement team in day-to-day operations, preparing purchase orders in Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central and tracking order confirmations & delivery dates and act as a point of contact for internal requesters.
  • You will request quotes, prepare offer comparisons and research new suppliers, especially for technical components in optics, lasers and lab equipment.
  • You will help keep our supplier and master data clean and complete, including trade compliance data such as HS codes and country of origin.
  • You will be involved in implementing AI applications and testing changes of our tools (Marvelous Request Center), and document processes and work instructions.
  • You will support goods receipt and internal distribution across our sites and help resolve delivery issues.
  • You will run spend analyses and prepare the results for management.

What you bring

  • You are studying Business Administration, Industrial Engineering or a comparable program.
  • Ideally, you have gained first experience in procurement, supply chain or finance, e.g. through an internship or working student position.
  • You work with a high level of diligence, quality awareness and independence, and take ownership of data quality and documentation.
  • You are cost-conscious and bring a can-do attitude.
  • You are curious about technical products and enjoy understanding what our engineers actually need.
  • You work in a team-oriented and communicative way.
  • You are proficient in MS Office, especially Excel and PowerPoint; experience with ERP systems (ideally Business Central), or AI tools is a plus.
  • You communicate confidently in German and English, both in writing and on the phone.
  • You are available for at least six months, ideally twelve, for 16–20 hours per week during the semester.

The impact you will make

As a key contributor at the forefront of high-power laser fusion science, you will play a pivotal role in shaping the future of laser technology, driving innovations that redefine energy generation. Collaborating with multidisciplinary teams and leading experts worldwide, your work will directly influence cutting-edge fusion concepts. This is a hands-on opportunity to grow in a dynamic, multinational environment while making a lasting impact on sustainable energy.

Your responsibilities

  • Build, operate and stabilize the frequency-comb front end — set up, run, lock and maintain the comb source in the lab.
  • Build, stabilize and characterize cavities — assemble, align, lock and optimize the reference and enhancement cavities.
  • Carry out the hands-on lab work of the subsystem — alignment, troubleshooting, measurement and optimization, working independently.
  • Work with the multidisciplinary team to integrate your subsystem with the amplification, synthesis and other advanced technologies into the overall system design.
  • Utilize common laser diagnostic and nonlinear techniques to measure and analyze ultrafast pulses.
  • Document experimental procedures, results, and design recommendations in a structured and traceable manner
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of the laser system, diagnostics and workflows.
  • Contribute to laser-operation procedures and safety protocols and ensure compliance with safety standards.

What you bring

  • Master's degree or PhD in Physics, Optical Engineering, Laser Engineering, Photonics, or a related field.
  • Experimental expertise across ultrafast-laser sources — diode-pumped solid-state, short-pulse and fiber lasers and amplifiers — and their diagnostics.
  • Practical experience with optical alignment, laser operation, and laboratory troubleshooting.
  • Hands-on experience in optical frequency combs and their stabilization
  • Hands-on experience with high-finesse optical cavities — alignment, locking, mode-matching, and finesse/loss optimization
  • Practical experience with locking electronics and feedback/servo loops
  • Programming and data-analysis skills (e.g. Python) for measurement automation and analysis.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a structured approach to technical challenges
  • A hands-on, self-driven and collaborative working style — you enjoy digging into complex problems with attention to detail in a dynamic, multidisciplinary team.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English

  • Experience with scientific diagnostics, optical instruments, laser facilities, beamlines, or experimental physics equipment.
  • Experience designing for high vacuum, cleanrooms, low vibration, thermal stability, or micron-level positioning and alignment.

This role requires expertise in mechanical design, vibration and thermal analysis and precision kinematics. You will collaborate closely with optical physicists and systems engineers to ensure the structural stability and adjustability of critical laser components under demanding operating conditions.

Your responsibilities

  • Design and optimize large optical mounts capable of maintaining micron/sub micron positioning and high angular stability under thermal loads, mechanical vibrations and environmental changes
  • Perform and interpret modal, harmonic, and random-vibration/PSD analyses to identify structural resonances and predict optical displacement and angular stability under realistic environmental excitation.
  • Translate thermal results into optomechanical performance, evaluating how temperature changes and gradients influence mirror displacement, tip/tilt, surface deformation, optical alignment, and wavefront quality.
  • Optimize structures for high eigenfrequencies and low vibration sensitivity while maintaining appropriate mass, manufacturability, accessibility, and adjustment capability.
  • Select appropriate materials based not only on mechanical strength but also on CTE, thermal conductivity, stiffness-to-mass ratio, dimensional stability, vacuum compatibility, and optical-system requirements.
  • Select and integrate precision adjustment components including threads, springs, flexures, bearings, actuators, motors, and precision stages, considering load capacity, stiffness, resolution, backlash, repeatability, and stability.
  • Use CAD tools and mechanical modeling software to develop and iterate on designs in collaboration with physicists and systems engineers
  • Support prototype testing and correlate FEA predictions with displacement, vibration, thermal, and alignment measurements.

What you bring

  • Proven experience designing large, stable optical mounts or optomechanical assemblies for high-energy laser systems
  • Strong understanding of precision mechanical design and kinematics, including spatial and angular degrees of freedom, stiffness, backlash, repeatability, and alignment.
  • Experience with thermal and thermo-mechanical simulation, including temperature gradients, thermal expansion, heat transfer, cooling concepts, and resulting structural deformation.
  • Good understanding of engineering materials and their relevant properties, including CTE, stiffness, thermal conductivity, dimensional stability, and vacuum compatibility.
  • Proficiency in CAD and mechanical modeling (e.g. SolidWorks, Inventor or similar), including thermal and vibrational analysis techniques
  • Ability to translate optical requirements into mechanical, thermal, positioning, and stability requirements and work effectively with optical engineers, physicists, controls engineers, and manufacturing teams.

What sets you apart

  • Direct experience with high-energy, high-power, or ultra-short-pulse laser systems, particularly compressors, stretchers, large mirrors, gratings, or beam-transport systems.
  • Experience designing optomechanical systems requiring micron/sub-micron positional precision and µrad or sub-µrad angular stability.
  • Understanding of how mechanical and thermal effects translate into optical performance, including wavefront distortion, mirror deformation, pointing stability, and alignment drift.
  • Experience with advanced simulation methods such as coupled thermal-structural analysis, harmonic response, and PSD/random-vibration analysis, including correlation with experimental measurements.
  • Hands-on experience with the manufacturing, assembly, alignment, testing, and validation of large precision optical systems.

We pioneered the Organic SolidFlow battery

CMBlu Energy is on an exciting journey towards becoming a global cleantech company. Our mission is to enable unlimited energy storage modelled on nature - for everyone, worldwide.

What are SolidFlow batteries?

SolidFlow batteries store energy in organic molecules. The absence of explosive materials makes them safe, the use of socially and ecologically conflict-free raw materials makes them sustainable and the almost unlimited availability of materials makes them scalable and cheap to procure. This makes our patented SolidFlow technology a game changer in the development of a global climate-neutral energy system.

From start-up to scale-up: we're tackling it together

CMBlu Energy is developing from a start-up focussing on research into a manufacturing scale-up that is on its way to series production. Around 240 employees are working towards this goal at CMBlu Energy. Our head office is in Alzenau near Frankfurt, with a branch office in Obernburg. There are also subsidiaries in Athens, Greece and Petaluma, USA.

SolidFlow batteries store energy in organic molecules. Gleichzeitig schaffen wir heute die Finance-Strukturen, die wir für unsere weitere Entwicklung und internationale Expansion benötigen. In dieser Rolle übernimmst Du nicht einfach bestehende Prozesse – Du gestaltest sie mit. Du entwickelst unser Group Accounting, Reporting und unsere Konsolidierungsstrukturen weiter und arbeitest eng mit Finance Leadership, CFO und Geschäftsführung zusammen. WARUM DIESE ROLLE? IFRS-Transformation: Gestalte die Umstellung unseres internationalen Reportings auf IFRS zum 01.01.2027 aktiv mit. Aufbau statt Verwaltung: Entwickle Group-Accounting-, Reporting- und Konsolidierungsstrukturen weiter und schaffe Standards, die mit unserem Wachstum skalieren. Hoher Gestaltungsspielraum: Du hast die Möglichkeit, Prozesse, Richtlinien und Strukturen aktiv mitzuprägen und Deine fachliche Expertise direkt einzubringen. Internationale Perspektive: Begleite den Aufbau unserer internationalen Gesellschaften und gestalte deren Integration in unsere zukünftige Gruppenstruktur mit. Impact & Ownership: Deine Arbeit schafft die Grundlage für eine belastbare und international ausgerichtete Finance-Organisation. Entwicklungsperspektive: Mit unserem Wachstum kann auch Dein Verantwortungsbereich wachsen – perspektivisch bis hin zur Verantwortung für Group Reporting & Consolidation und zum Aufbau eines Teams. Scale-up mit Corporate-Anspruch: Du verbindest die Dynamik eines wachsenden Unternehmens mit anspruchsvollen Finance-Themen und der Möglichkeit, Strukturen von Grund auf mitzugestalten. ÜBER UNS Wir verstehen die Halbleiterindustrie als ein Universum voller Möglichkeiten. Wir erkennen Chancen und sehen das transformative Potenzial, das unsere Graphen-Lösungen für die Neugestaltung der Branche mit sich bringen. Wir laden Dich ein, diesen Wandel gemeinsam mit uns voranzutreiben, indem wir kluge Köpfe mit einer gemeinsamen Vision zusammenbringen. Diese Vision ist es, zu zeigen, dass grundlegende Veränderungen möglich sind. Mit Deinem Wissen und Deinen Fähigkeiten kannst Du beweisen, dass Dinge anders – und besser – gemacht werden können. Gemeinsam haben wir die Kraft, das Paradigma zu verändern, wie die Welt vernetzt ist. UNSERE TECHNOLOGY Die steigenden Anforderungen der Halbleiterindustrie an leistungsfähigere Chips mit höherer Bandbreite und geringerem Energieverbrauch werden durch unsere Technologie adressiert. Wir ermöglichen die Verbindung von Chips mit Hochdurchsatz-Computernetzwerken bei minimaler Latenz. Der entscheidende Faktor ist die Nutzung der einzigartigen physikalischen Eigenschaften von Graphen, um elektronische Datenverarbeitung mit photonischer Kommunikation zu vereinen. Dadurch können unzählige Chips miteinander interagieren, als wären sie ein einziges System. Unsere Graphen-Photonik-Innovation hebt Rechenleistung und Effizienz auf ein neues Niveau. Kurz gesagt: Wir vernetzen Chips zu leistungsstarken, energieeffizienten Systemen und überwinden mit unserer Graphen-Technologie die bisherigen Grenzen der Konnektivität in der Halbleiterindustrie. DEINE AUFGABEN Group Accounting & IFRS: Du baust unsere Group-Accounting- und IFRS-Strukturen weiter auf und entwickelst sie im Zuge unserer internationalen Expansion kontinuierlich weiter. Konsolidierung & Group Reporting: Du verantwortest zentrale Themen rund um Konsolidierung, Group Reporting und die Weiterentwicklung unserer gruppenweiten Reporting-Strukturen. Internationale Gesellschaften: Du begleitest den Aufbau und die Integration unserer internationalen Tochtergesellschaften und entwickelst die dafür notwendigen Accounting-Strukturen weiter. Zusammenarbeit & Ownership: Du arbeitest eng mit Finance Leadership, CFO, Geschäftsführung und relevanten Stakeholdern zusammen und bringst Deine Expertise dort ein, wo fachliche Tiefe und Hands-on-Umsetzung gefragt sind. DAS BRINGST DU MIT - Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Group Accounting, Konzernrechnungswesen, in der Konsolidierung oder im internationalen Reporting - Fundierte IFRS-Kenntnisse und Erfahrung mit internationalen Accounting-Strukturen - Erfahrung mit internationalen Gesellschaftsstrukturen und deren Accounting-Anforderungen - Nachweisbare Erfahrung in der Entwicklung und Weiterentwicklung gruppenweiter Accounting-, Reporting- oder Konsolidierungsprozesse - Erfahrung darin, Finance-Transformationen, Veränderungsprojekte oder vergleichbare Aufbauprojekte aktiv voranzutreiben - Ausgeprägte Hands-on-Mentalität, Verantwortungsbewusstsein und Freude daran, Strukturen selbstständig aufzubauen - Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse WAS WIR DIR BIETEN Entwicklung: Mit dem Wachstum von Black Semiconductor kann auch Dein Verantwortungsbereich wachsen – perspektivisch bis hin zur Verantwortung für Group Reporting & Consolidation und zum Aufbau eines Teams. Beteiligung: Du erhältst virtuelle Aktienoptionen und partizipierst damit am langfristigen Erfolg unseres Unternehmens. Flexibilität: Wir arbeiten hybrid mit einer Anwesenheit von ca. einem Tag pro Woche in Aachen. Gesundheit & Zukunft: Deine Gesundheit und Zukunft sind uns wichtig. Wir bieten Dir ein umfassendes Leistungspaket mit Versicherungs-, Vorsorge- und weiteren Benefits. Zukunftsbranche: Arbeite an einer Technologie, die die nächste Generation der Halbleiter-Konnektivität mitgestalten soll. UNSERE KULTUR Menschen vor Prozessen. Bei Black Semiconductor ist Flexibilität der Schlüssel - wir sorgen dafür, dass sich die Arbeit dem Leben anpasst und nicht umgekehrt. Wir setzen uns für die Vereinbarkeit von Beruf und Privatleben ein, damit Karrieren sinnvoll und bereichernd sind. Unsere Prozesse sind menschenzentriert, damit Du dich auf das Wesentliche konzentrieren kannst. Lass uns gemeinsam wachsen. Dein Potenzial ist unsere Priorität. Wir bieten Dir die nötige Autonomie, um etwas zu bewirken, und fördern Dein Wachstum durch eine Kultur des kontinuierlichen Lernens. Wir investieren in Deine berufliche und persönliche Entwicklung. Wir leben Offenheit. Zusammenarbeit und Inklusion sind die Eckpfeiler unserer Kultur. Wir praktizieren Offenheit und fördern Vertrauen und Respekt. Individualität ist unsere kollektive Stärke, die uns zu Innovationen antreibt und uns voranbringt. Wir verbinden Chips – und Menschen. Wir ermutigen qualifizierte Personen mit beliebigem Hintergrund, sich zu bewerben. Wir fördern ein integratives und unterstützendes Arbeitsumfeld, das Zusammenarbeit, Innovation und Wachstum schätzt. ashby:blacksemiconductor:https://jobs.as.title: Senior SoC Architect (f/m/d)
ashby:blacksemiconductor:https://jobs.as.description: About us We see the semiconductor industry as a realm of possibility. We see opportunity. We see the profound impact that our graphene solutions will have in transforming the industry. We invite you to join us in driving change with our fundamentally human-centered approach, uniting bright minds around a shared vision. The vision is: Prove to everybody that you can make a fundamental change. Prove with your knowledge and skills how things can be done differently. Together, we can change the paradigm of how the world connects About our technology The semiconductor industry’s growing demand for more powerful chips with higher bandwidth and lower power finds its solution in our technology. We connect chips to high-throughput, low-delay computing networks. The key lies in harnessing the physical properties of graphene to combine electronic computing with photonic communication, allowing countless chips to interact almost as if they were one. Our graphene photonic innovation increases computing power and efficiency to a new order of magnitude In short, we connect chips to create powerful and energy-efficient networks, overcoming connectivity limitations in the semiconductor industry. We deliver the graphene solution The Role We are seeking a skilled Senior SoC Architect at Black Semiconductor to drive the architecture of our entire Electronics-Photonics IC (EPIC) SoC, translating the Marketing Requirement Document (MRD) into a complete, internally consistent, and implementable Product Requirement Document (PRD) covering digital, analog, I/O, and memory subsystems. You will own the digital and high-speed I/O subsystem architecture directly, with particular depth in high-speed SerDes and the protocol digital logic for UCIe, PCIe, and Ethernet. Working closely with the Analog/RF System Architect, Photonics System Architect, Package Electrical/SI Architect, memory subsystem owner, product management, and engineering teams, you will integrate their subsystem architectures into one coherent overall product architecture. To join our team, you should be excited to - Own the overall EPIC SoC technical leadership from initial concept through production and drive cross-functional technical alignment across photonics, analog, digital, technology, and product teams. - Build and document the overall product architecture, translating the MRD into a complete PRD and ensuring architectural decisions, technical requirements, dependencies, and trade-offs are consistently aligned across teams. - Own the digital subsystem architecture, including core logic, on-chip interconnect fabric, and subsystem partitioning. - Own the high-speed I/O subsystem architecture, with particular depth in high-speed SerDes and the protocol digital logic for UCIe, PCIe, and Ethernet, including how protocol layers map onto the physical SerDes implementation. - Partner with the Analog/RF System Architect, Photonics System Architect, Package Electrical/SI Architect, and memory subsystem owner to integrate their architectures and ensure the full-chip architecture is internally consistent and feasible within the target electrical, physical, and packaging constraints. - Drive full-chip performance, power, and area (PPA) trade-off analysis, partner with external vendors/3rd-party IP providers on full-chip validation and characterization teams on product characterization, and make the calls needed to keep the PRD internally consistent. - Present the integrated architecture and PRD to product management and engineering leadership and own it through to sign-off. Your Qualifications ESSENTIAL - 7–10 years of experience in SoC or product architecture roles, with proven SoC/product architecture ownership and demonstrated experience taking a product from MRD-level requirements through a complete, implementable PRD-level architecture covering multiple subsystems and at least one full product architecture cycle. - Deep, hands-on high-speed I/O subsystem expertise, particularly high-speed SerDes and the protocol digital logic for UCIe, PCIe, and Ethernet, including how protocol requirements shape physical-layer architecture. - Strong digital subsystem and interconnect fabric architecture experience, including defining on-chip interconnect and digital subsystem partitioning for a complex SoC. - Strong cross-domain integration skills, with the ability to take analog, photonic, packaging, and memory architecture input from peer subsystem owners and integrate it into one internally consistent PRD without needing to personally own those domains. - Experience translating marketing/product-level requirements into precise, engineering-actionable architecture specifications and reasoning about full-chip performance, power, and area (PPA) trade-offs. - Experience with 3rd-party IP vendors, including evaluating and selecting external IPs and design integration partners. - Experience with architecture specification and requirements management tooling for authoring and maintaining the PRD and tracing it back to the MRD; UCIe, PCIe, and Ethernet protocol/standards documentation and compliance tooling; architecture and performance modeling tools, including custom or commercial full-chip performance/power models; Python / C++ for modeling, scripting, and analysis; and collaboration and documentation platforms for coordinating input from analog, photonics, packaging, memory, and other subsystem architects into a single PRD. NICE TO HAVE - Previous experience serving as an SoC Chief Engineer, with end-to-end accountability for a product's full-chip architecture, schedule, and quality outcomes. - Familiarity with silicon photonics or electro-optic I/O, and how it changes traditional I/O subsystem architecture assumptions. - Familiarity with advanced packaging, including 2.5D/3D and chiplet integration, and its impact on full-chip architecture choices. - Experience working directly with product management and/or customers to shape MRD-level requirements. - Experience with CXL or other die-to-die/coherent interconnect standards adjacent to UCIe/PCIe. Our work culture People Over Processes. At Black Semiconductor, flexibility is key—we ensure work adapts to life, not the other way around. ashby:blacksemiconductor:https://jobs.as.description: Die Rolle Wir suchen einen erfahrenen Ingenieur Automatisierungstechnik / Automatisierungstechniker (m/w/d), der die technische Verantwortung für unser Facilities Monitoring and Control System (FMCS) übernimmt – das System, das den Betrieb unserer Produktion sicherstellt. Pflege und Weiterentwicklung des Systems durch die Integration neuer Datenpunkte, Visualisierungen, Berichte und Alarmkonzepte sowie die Sicherstellung einer aktuellen technischen Dokumentation - Technischer Ansprechpartner für externe Dienstleister, Lieferanten und Auditoren sowie Unterstützung bei Qualifizierungen, Abnahmen und Change-Control-Prozessen Diese Qualifikationen bringst du mit - Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Elektroniker für Automatisierungstechnik mit Weiterbildung zum staatlich geprüften Techniker oder abgeschlossenes Studium der Elektrotechnik, Automatisierungstechnik oder eines vergleichbaren Fachgebietes - ashby:blacksemiconductor:https://jobs.as.description: SAP S/4HANA FACHBEREICHSKOORDINATOR (M/W/D) ÜBER UNS Wir sehen die Halbleiterindustrie als Raum voller Möglichkeiten. Wir sehen Chancen. Wir laden dich ein, diesen Wandel mitzugestalten und mit unserem konsequent menschenorientierten Ansatz kluge Köpfe für eine gemeinsame Vision zu vereinen. Unsere Vision: Zeige allen, dass du grundlegende Veränderungen bewirken kannst. Beweise mit deinem Wissen und deinen Fähigkeiten, dass Dinge auch anders gemacht werden können. Gemeinsam verändern wir die Art und Weise, wie die Welt miteinander verbunden ist. ÜBER UNSERE TECHNOLOGIE Die Halbleiterindustrie benötigt zunehmend leistungsfähigere Chips mit höherer Bandbreite und geringerem Energieverbrauch. ashby:vaeridion:https://jobs.ashbyhq.com.title: Senior Battery Algorithms Engineer (all genders)
ashby:vaeridion:https://jobs.ashbyhq.com.description: Your Mission: We are developing a next-generation electric aircraft propulsion system, with the propulsion battery designed, developed, and validated in-house. Accurate real-time observation and prediction of the battery’s State of Function (SoF), the energy and power actually accessible for safe flight and landing, is the safety-critical output of the battery system, and the basis for pre-flight planning, in-flight energy management, and the energy information presented to the crew. SoF is built on the underlying battery states that your algorithms observe and predict: state of charge (SoC), state of health (SoH), state of power (SoP), state of energy (SoE), and state of balance (SoB). Erroneous observation or prediction of SoF is classified as a catastrophic condition, since it can lead the crew to commit to a flight or an approach the battery cannot support. This makes the function certification-critical and places exacting demands on the accuracy, robustness, and verifiability of every algorithm you deliver. As a Senior Battery Algorithms Engineer (all genders), you will join the VÆRIDION Technology team and take ownership of the development and validation of the state observers, estimators, and predictors that determine SoF for our lithium-ion propulsion battery systems. This is a hands-on senior role in which you lead the modeling, simulation, algorithm development, test-data analysis, and validation behind these states, and set the methodology the team works to. Your Day-to-Day: - Own the end-to-end development and validation of battery state observers, estimators, and predictors for SoF, SoC, SoH, SoP, SoE, and SoB across cell, cell-bank, and pack level - Parameterize multi-RC equivalent-circuit models (OCV, R0, RC pairs, hysteresis, thermal, and aging effects) from cell supplier data, virtual and physical test benches, and HiL rigs - ashby:vaeridion:https://jobs.ashbyhq.com.description: Your Mission: As Senior Stress & Thermomechanical FEA Engineer – Propulsion Battery System (all genders) you will join VÆRIDION’s Technology division within the Mechanical Design & Integration team and lead the structural, stress, and thermomechanical finite element analysis (FEA) of the propulsion battery system for VÆRIDION’s CS-23 all-electric aircraft. You will own the computational modelling of battery packs, power distribution units (PDUs), and their internal hardware, predicting how every component behaves under nominal and emergency conditions – including thermal runaway, the DO-160 environmental qualification conditions applied to the pack and PDU as airborne equipment (temperature and altitude, temperature variation, humidity, operational shocks and crash safety, and vibration), flight loads, and durability over service life. Your analysis will provide engineering evidence that the propulsion battery system is structurally robust, thermally safe, and certifiable. You will be the structural and thermomechanical analysis authority for the propulsion battery system, responsible for checking and releasing design against the applicable stress and thermomechanical requirements. Your work will directly contribute to the propulsion battery system that underpins VÆRIDION’s mission to bring electric flight to regional aviation. Your Day-to-Day: - Lead the structural, stress, and thermomechanical FEA of propulsion battery packs, PDUs, and their internal components, predicting how they behave under nominal operation and emergency conditions – including thermal runaway, the DO-160 environmental qualification conditions, and flight and inertial loads. - Perform room-temperature and elevated-temperature analysis of composites (including sandwich structures), metals, adhesives, and mechanical fasteners, capturing temperature-dependent material behaviour. - Build and correlate nonlinear models covering material, geometric, and contact nonlinearity – including cohesive-zone and VCCT delamination, composite progressive failure and damage propagation, metal plasticity and rate-dependent behaviour, crushable foam plasticity and densification, large-deformation and post-buckling response, and frictional contact with bolt pretension, including bearing behaviour at fastener holes (bearing yield, hole elongation, and bearing–bypass interaction). - Model the hyper-elastic and viscoelastic behaviour of potting compounds, gap fillers, foams, gaskets, seals, and thermal interface materials to predict contact pressure and interface integrity across the life of the pack. - Perform durability and life analysis across the differing service lives of components within the system, covering vibration-induced high-cycle fatigue (DO-160 random and sine sweep), low-cycle fatigue from ground–air–ground and charge/discharge thermal cycling, and fatigue of bonded joints, fasteners, busbars, and interconnects. - Analyse thermal runaway response as a coupled thermomechanical event – pressure loads, direct impingement flow, ejecta, and heat transfer to surrounding structure and systems – working closely with the Thermal Systems team on thermal runaway CFD modelling and the resulting heat transfer boundary conditions, in support of containment and continued safe flight and landing. - Define modelling standards, assumptions, load cases, and acceptance criteria, and maintain configuration-controlled analysis models and inputs. - Support test planning and post-test correlation of FEA models against coupon, component, and full-scale test data. - Author and release certification documentation, including analysis reports and means-of-compliance evidence for structural, environmental, and thermal runaway requirements. Your Profile: - Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Structural/Computational Mechanics, or a related field; a PhD in a relevant area is beneficial. - 5+ years of experience in structural/stress and thermomechanical FEA, preferably in aerospace, automotive, battery systems, or other high-performance engineering environments. - Experience taking analytical responsibility for hardware, including checking the work of others and providing stress sign-off or equivalent release approval within a configuration-controlled environment, is desirable. - Strong command of nonlinear FEA across material, geometric, and contact nonlinearity, with depth in several of the following: cohesive-zone modeling with traction–separation, composite progressive failure (e.g., Hashin/Puck), metal plasticity and viscoplasticity, hyperelastic and viscoelastic materials, crushable foam plasticity, large-deformation and buckling, and frictional contact with pretension, including fastener bearing and bearing–bypass analysis. - Experience with room-temperature and elevated-temperature modeling of composites (including sandwich structures), metals, adhesives, and mechanical fasteners, covering temperature-dependent material behavior. - Experience in fatigue and damage-tolerance analysis (S–N/ε–N methods, cumulative damage, random-vibration/PSD fatigue) and in creep and stress-relaxation behavior of adhesives and polymers at elevated temperature. - Experience with explicit dynamics and impact/blast-type events (e.g., burst-disk actuation, vent impingement, ejecta and debris containment) is desirable. - Proficiency with FEA software, ideally Abaqus; experience with Siemens NX is beneficial. - Experience applying static, fatigue, and creep material property allowables to the substantiation of structural hardware, including familiarity with CMH-17 and MMPDS methodologies or equivalent, and with A-/B-basis statistical allowables. - Familiarity with aerospace environmental and structural requirements, in particular DO-160 environmental conditions and CS-23 structural substantiation, is desirable. - Working knowledge of propulsion battery thermal runaway means of compliance, including DO-311A and the ANAC–EASA–FAA–TCCA harmonized thermal runaway white paper for propulsion batteries, is beneficial. - Familiarity with development assurance and safety processes (e.g., ARP4754A/B, ARP4761/4761A, and ASTM F3230 for small aircraft) is beneficial. - Experience with battery systems or electric propulsion systems is beneficial. - Strong problem-solving skills, technical curiosity, and attention to detail. - Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to work effectively in a multidisciplinary engineering environment. - Fluent English language skills are essential; ashby:vaeridion:https://jobs.ashbyhq.com.title: Mechanical Systems Engineer - Landing Gear (all genders)
ashby:vaeridion:https://jobs.ashbyhq.com.description: Your Mission: We are looking for a Mechanical Systems Engineer to help us develop and integrate the Landing Gear System of our fully battery-electric aircraft (CS-23). You will take a leading role in defining, integrating and certifying the retractable landing gear system of a clean-sheet battery-electric aircraft, including extension/retraction actuation, wheels & brakes, tires, steering, anti-skid functions and associated indication sub-systems. Your work will span the full system development lifecycle, from system-level requirements, architecture and functional analysis through preliminary and detailed design, supplier involvement, prototype assembly support, ground & flight testing and certification.
